p2c27.caption: Idle talk — scattered saying, no floor
p2c27.content_rationale: §35: idle talk (Gerede) is groundless saying — communication that has lost the primary relation to what is talked about and spreads by gossiping and passing the word along until its lack of grounds grows to complete groundlessness (Bodenlosigkeit, p4). It closes off rather than disclosing (p6), yet Dasein can never escape the interpretedness it grows into (p7). The opener stages saying-without-floor: a dim straight shaft with talk-scatter drifting across the whole scene and nothing gathered at the bottom.

p2c28.caption: Curiosity — everywhere and nowhere
p2c28.content_rationale: §36: curiosity is the tendency toward just-seeing (lumen naturale tradition, p1; Augustine, p4) that abandons itself to the world: never dwelling anywhere (Unverweilen), seeking novelty only to leap to the next novelty (p8). De-distancing sight flees what is nearest for the distant and strange (p6–p7). The opener pulls light and flecks OFF-AXIS toward the right margin — circumspection that cannot stay.

p2c29.caption: Ambiguity — everything looks understood
p2c29.content_rationale: §37: ambiguity (Zweideutigkeit) is the double-semblance in which everything looks genuinely understood while nothing is decided (p1): curiosity and idle talk make sure the genuine is outdated as soon as it emerges (p4), tossing to curiosity what it seeks and giving idle talk the illusion of decidedness (p6). The opener DOUBLES every fleck — a dim twin offset down-right — and ghosts a second shaft at 0.18: semblance layered on semblance.

p2c30.caption: Falling — the plunge
p2c30.content_rationale: §38: falling (Verfallen) gathers §§35–37 into one motion — temptation, tranquillization, alienation, entanglement (Verfangnis) — named the plunge (Absturz): Dasein plunges out of itself into the groundlessness of inauthentic everydayness while the public interpretation calls it 'getting ahead' (p14). Turbulence reveals thrownness as tossing-about (p15). The opener tilts the shaft to a binding 38° and dims it 30%: light itself falls; flecks sink to the lower gap.

The opener HOLDS the shaft mid-air: it fades out at y=560 against a bark stop-line — the question asked, the answer withheld. Sparse flecks; the quietest scene in the cohort, a held breath before §40.

p2c32.caption: Anxiety — the nothing and nowhere
p2c32.content_rationale: §40 CLIMAX (Phase-B prototype chapter): anxiety discloses the nothing and nowhere — what threatens is nowhere, yet so near it takes breath away (p11); innerworldly beings sink into complete insignificance and the world as world obtrudes (p12); afterward we say 'it was really nothing' (p13). Everyday familiarity collapses; Dasein is individualized as not-being-at-home, uncanny (p15). Fear is fallen anxiety (p19). The opener is the cohort's inversion: trunks crowd INWARD, a cold-white pillar replaces straw light, and the ONLY Div One ember floor (B5) burns beneath — dread made visible.

p2c33.caption: Care — the threefold braid
p2c33.content_rationale: §41 CLIMAX: care (Sorge) as the primordial totality — being-ahead-of-oneself-already-in-(the-world) as being-together-with (p6): existentiality, facticity, and falling as one woven coherence that essentially cannot be split up (p10). p2c34.caption: Cura — she shapes the clay
p2c34.content_rationale: §42: the Hyginus Cura fable as pre-ontological confirmation — Care crosses the river, shapes clay, receives spirit from Jupiter, is contested by Earth, and Saturn judges: Cura holds the creature as long as it lives; it is called homo from humus (p4–p6). Cura prima finxit (p7); thrown project as care's twofold structure (p9). The opener drops to EARTH-REGISTER: river band, shaping hand over worked clay, Saturn's three judgment ticks — archaic, material, quiet after the §41 climax.

p2c35.caption: Reality — the dissolving question
p2c35.content_rationale: §43: the reality problem dismantled — Kant's 'scandal of philosophy' (no proof of the external world, p11) dissolves once the worldless subject is refused: the 'problem of reality' is an impossible one because its very theme repudiates that line of questioning (p23); the cogito inverts to sum = I-am-in-a-world (p34). The opener sets FALSE FRAMES alight at their corners: the question burns edge-inward and hollows out — argument-by-immolation.

p2c36.caption: Truth — Dasein is in the truth
p2c36.content_rationale: §44 CLIMAX (7106 words, longest in Division One): truth as unconcealment — discoveredness must be wrested, even robbed, from concealment (p34); the goddess of truth sets Parmenides before two paths, discovering and concealment (p35); 'Dasein is in the truth' (p28); 'There is' being only insofar as truth is, and truth only as long as Dasein is (p61). The opener is the cohort's CULMINATING BRIGHTNESS: trunks step OUTWARD to the widest gap (52%), the torn edge of concealment glows at the floor, two paths fork from the goddess-line — and the Parmenides epigraph rail (B7) carries the fragment.
